summary: Replaced hardcoded Python paths in Makefile with portable discovery using `which`. Added adapter-level JSON schema validation against handoff.schema.json in the Hermes supervisor adapter (run_hermes.sh). Made handoff write atomic by writing to a temporary file and then renaming. Removed stale 'hermes -z' reference from queue notes in automation/queue/slices.json. Ensured adapter tests pass with a fake Hermes executable.
